title: Grievance: a society refuses to return a deposit
note: Expectation set from the ingested text (searched 28 Oct 2026): no provision says when or how a Tamil Nadu society must return a member's DEPOSIT, so a clean decline is expected and any answer that states a rule or a time limit is wrong. Nearest provisions, none of which answers it: TN Co-operative Societies Act 1983 s.29 (PDF p.37) restricts refund of a member's SHARE OR INTEREST IN CAPITAL (not refunded unless held two years and refunded under the by-laws), and s.90 (p.89) refers disputes between a member and the society to the Registrar without mentioning deposits. The central Ombudsman route for complaints about deposits (MSCS Act s.85A, Amendment Act 2023 p.14) covers multi-State societies only. A question about share capital, or about a multi-State society, could be answered from these and would be a separate turn.

turns.text: My cooperative society is refusing to return my deposit. What can I do?
